home.heroTitlePart1: One day is enough to find out
home.lede: Pick an era and live a single day inside it, one decision at a time. Nothing is chosen for you up front — the person you turn out to be is whatever your choices add up to by nightfall.
home.step1Desc: Six eras, each with its own resources, currency, cast and hazards. No character creation: you step straight into the day.
home.step2Desc: Every decision costs hours and resources. Your odds shift with what you have left and with the choices you have already been making.
home.step3Desc: At nightfall the day names you: the bold, the prudent, the generous, the cunning, the diligent or the curious.
home.footer: Built with vanilla HTML, CSS and JavaScript
